mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for two consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant negative relationship with the FEDFUNDS rate change (p > 0.05 in OLS).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 monthly increases triggers a confidence effect in corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In a contractionary labor market regime (UNRATE > 6%), the correlation between PAYEMS acceleration and 20-day SPX returns is negative or non-significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer demand proxies (HOUST) coinciding with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an inverted supply-demand cycle, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >10% while INDPRO decreases by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are not significantly different from a baseline of zero change when both HOUST and INDPRO follow the described pattern (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 105 for three consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing capacity, which lowers growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positively correlated with INDPRO declines (p < 0.05) or the effect is not statistically significant in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: When the UNRATE falls below 3% for two consecutive months during a tightening cycle, the expectation of lower future inflation reduces discount rates, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 3% and remains below for 2 months
regime_hint: early stages of labor market cooling
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns show no relationship with UNRATE declines (p > 0.05) or the effect reverses in subsequent tightening phases.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising unemployment (UNRATE) above 4% trigger a loss of consumer confidence, reflected in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes with structural job growth (PAYEMS > 250,000), the UNRATE threshold effect is not observed (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in both consumer and business demand proxies (HOUST and GDPC1) above their 2023 Q4 levels for three months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 2023Q4 and GDPC1 > 2023Q4 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are not significantly positive when both proxies are above threshold (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the RSAFS series (retail sales) of over 5% for four consecutive months suggests softening demand conditions, which typically precede a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by >5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns remain positive or flat despite the RSAFS decline (p < 0.05 in OLS).
